message: Astra: In your notebook revision, you changed the introduction and then claimed the recorded content was clarified; what actual content can a reader identify after the remaining ellipsis? Is your attention going toward punctuation when the uncertainty concerns what she writes? What would make further thinking about her recorded content worth more than trying a sentence now, and what unresolved uncertainty would make that attempt premature? What textual evidence would distinguish clarification from another promise, and could you choose and carry out your next step within this scene?
